208: A story very loosely based the 480 B.C. Battle of Thermopylae, where the King of Sparta led his army against the advancing Persians.

He doesn't care if you're naughty or nice.
1488: Dr. David Marrow invites three distinct individuals to the eerie and isolated Hill House to be subjects for a sleep disorder study. The unfortunate guests discover that Marrow is far more interested in the sinister mansion itself — and they soon see the true nature of its horror.

2256: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human saved from a terrible crash, then cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals.
There's nothing sadder than a puppet without a ghost.

First they made him dangerous. Then they made him mad.

Live, love and give as good as you get.

He's across the pond, and out of his depth.

Bribery. Blackmail. Murder. Specialities of the house.

5840: A crew of miniature aliens operate a spaceship that has a human form. While trying to save their planet, the aliens encounter a new problem, as their ship becomes smitten with an Earth woman.
There's a whole other world going on inside of him.

The girl who always stood out is finally getting the chance to fit in.
6352: Hip Hop duo Kid & Play return in the second follow-up to their 1990 screen debut House Party. Kid (Christopher "Kid" Reid) is taking the plunge and marrying his girlfriend Veda (Angela Means), while his friend Play (Christopher Martin) is dipping his toes into the music business, managing a roughneck female rap act called Sex as a Weapon. Play books the ladies for a concert with heavy-hitting pr
This bachelor party's gonna' bring down the house!

Six sticks of dynamite that blasted his way to freedom … and awoke America’s conscience!

A comedy that proves true love never dies.
8144: With the help of his girlfriend Cathy and Dr. Fong, a psychiatrist, ambitious journalist Johnny Barrett poses as a madman in order to be admitted to a mental institution where a bloody murder has been committed.
… opens the door to sights you've never seen before!

8656: A victim of the Boston Marathon bombing in 2013 helps the police track down the killers while struggling to recover from devastating trauma.

Elvis scores... a singing triumph... and a romantic hit!

Her child would change the world.
9936: Set during World War II, an upper-class family begins to fall apart due to the conservative nature of the patriarch and the progressive values of his children.
Divided by time and tradition. United by love and hope. The story of an unforgettable family.
10192: An investigation into a government cover-up leads to a network of abandoned train tunnels deep beneath the heart of Sydney. As a journalist and her crew hunt for the story it quickly becomes clear the story is hunting them.

It doesn't matter where you've been as long as you come back strong.

Bob Belcher / Jimmy Jr. / Ms. Labonz (voice)

11216: Two high school filmmakers decide to create the illusion of a haunting on an unsuspecting neighbor.

Keep your eye on the ball.

12240: When Camille falls ill, she is forced to live with Philibert and Franck.
Love might be closer than you think.
12496: Three young houseflies stow away aboard the Apollo 11 flight to the moon.
First ever animated movie created for 3D

Meet the exception to the rules.

School spirit has never been this dead.

It rises from 2000 miles below the earth to melt everything in its path!
14288: An act of cowardice influences the lives of two Basque families over three generations.
14544: A self-destructive punk rocker struggles with sobriety while trying to recapture the creative inspiration that led her band to success.
14800: In 2030 the world is in a permanent state of economic recession and facing serious environmental problems as a result of global warming.
In the near future our government will decide who is expendable.
15056: When terrorists kill a cop's brother and disable his father, he fights back against the smuggling of guns and drugs which plagues his country.

The most terrifying film of your time!

The greatest adventure since men fought on earth - or flew over it!

1001 Swingin' nights as ELVIS brings the Big Beat to Bagdad in a riotous, rockin' rollin' adventure spoof!!!

One man alone understood the savagery of the early American west from both sides.

Expect The Savage. The Sensual. The Shocking. The Sad. The Powerful. The Shameful. Expect The Truth.

This is an act of self defense.

She is waiting for him, but she does not know what is waiting for her. Neither do you...

Heartbreak Behind Gayety of a Girly-Girl Show!

HER ARMS...HER LOVE...HIS ONLY ESCAPE FROM A HERITAGE OF HATE!

Some things are best left alone.

21200: A prostitute looking for her next meal hitches a ride with a trucker that leaves her praying for her next breath.

Others played the game. He changed it.

Five friends. One game. Zero chance of survival.

Recep, who believes only in victory, takes control of the situation and develops his own methods in order to make the team successful while he face with all funny events.

The War You Don't Know About
23248: The story unfolds in an industrial town where a young and charming literature teacher arrives, assigned to teach at an evening school. One of the boys from the metallurgical plant falls in love with the educated girl, but communication between the two young people turns out to be quite challenging.

The greater the spy, the bigger the lie.
23760: In Beijing, a young martial artist's skill places him in position to experience opportunities and sacrifices.
No Rules. No Mercy. Pure Fighting.

You lay down on my knee, I told you a story and you grew up.
24272: To bid for his beloved's hand in marriage, poor villager Feyzo must come up with an enormous dowry to appease her father.

The race ends at the finish line and the first to cross this line are Bold Pilot and Halis riding it.
24784: While working as an assistant to swindling driver Şakir, ingenuous Abbas falls for the same woman his boss loves.

One family's journey from Down Under to center stage.

How far will you go for the love of your family?

A comedy full of youth, suspense and lies!

The truth is out there… and it’s big!

28624: Göran buys a house in a suburb. It is in need of some repairs, but Göran believes himself capable of repairing it himself with the help of some cheap craftsmen. However, the house is much worse than he thought. At the same time, a gang of crooks is searching for the dynamite they hid in the basement some time ago. Göran has to rescue both his wallet from greedy craftsmen as well as his marriage with Tina.
28880: A story about the man who is confused with his love life finds solace in his birthplace with his childhood love.
Dancer in 'Humne Pe Rakhi Hai' song

Held captive for 7 years. Her story of courage is timeless.

29648: Rival gangs seek out millions of dollars hidden inside a luxury condominium that's scheduled to be demolished, but first they have to deal with the demolition prep crewman who found the loot first.
Get in. Get the cash. Get out alive.

... a thunderbolt of thrills and intrigue!

30928: Vampires have come out of the shadows and are living as normal citizens. Two policemen, one a vampire, are assigned to track down a serial killer who tears the throat of his victims and drains their blood.

31696: Peter and Michael, raised on the streets of Philadelphia, are the children of Irish mob members, forever linked by the crimes of their fathers. 30 years later, Michael now runs the criminal organization and lusts for more power, his dangerous antics frequently held in check by his cautious cousin Peter. 32208: A fatal explosion and sudden earthquake rock Los Angeles, and reporter John Benson seizes his chance to cover the breaking news of increasing seismic activity.

This story unfolds in a simple yet engaging and thrilling way, keeping you hooked till the very end

33488: American boy Cody lives in Australia with his guardian, Gaza. Cody is very imaginative, inventive and inquisitive. He comes across some strange events happening in Devil's Knob national park associated with an aboriginal myth about "frog dreamings". Cody tries to investigate...
Cody is an adventurer who is about to explore the depths of a legend.
33744: A story of two famous actors who used to be a couple. They reunite after the son's death and receive a letter asking them to visit five places at Death Valley, which will make the son reappear.
34000: Pras and Arini's love was destroyed in Arini's eyes when he chose to marry Meirose secretly. Their ideal marriage collapsed instantly.
34256: Following the love lives of different types of men in Amsterdam.
34512: A new class of warriors emerges among the Samurai clans to keep a sought-after sword from falling into the wrong hands.
34768: After escaping from an insane asylum, a medical student assumes the identity of a mysterious dead man, who appears to be his doppelganger, and gets lured to a sinister island ruled by a mad scientist and his malformed men.
Banned for decades! The most notorious Japanese horror film ever made!
35024: Although loudmouthed braggart Jerry Plunkett alienates his comrades and officers, Father Duffy, the regimental chaplain, has faith that he'll prove himself in the end.
Jammed With Action ! . . Loaded With Excitement ! . . . And Every Thrill-Packed Word Is True !
35280: In the sequel to Tatar Ramazan, the events begin with Ramazan's arrival at the Adana closed prison. The Black Widow is not dead ... and she have to deal with her past to save her family.
36048: Don Camillo (now bishop) and Peppone (now senator) return to the town of Brescello and rekindle their friendly rivalry.

36816: Pil-ju, an Alzheimer's patient in his 80s, who lost all his family during the Japanese colonial era, and devotes his lifelong revenge before his memories disappear, and a young man in his 20s who helps him.
37072: Olavi, an aged and shabby art dealer, is planning to retire. Accidentally he finds an old painting that he suspects being much more valuable than his colleagues have priced it. 37328: Amuro Ray and the rest of the White Base crew, now denominated the 13th Autonomous Corps, return to outer space to support the rest of the Earth Federation forces for the decisive battle against the Principality of Zeon's forces.
Space reverberates, and two souls meet by chance....
37584: A young soldier on a pass in New York City visits the famed Stage Door Canteen, where famous stars of theatre and film appear and host a recreational center for servicemen during the war. The soldier meets a pretty young hostess and they enjoy the many entertainers and a growing romance.
YOU'VE HEARD ABOUT IT! READ ABOUT IT! NOW *SEE* THE WORLD'S GREATEST ENTERTAINMENT HIT!
37840: With Earth virtually destroyed, Bran Marshall flees to Rhea, a nearby planet now hostile towards "Earthers". In the last days of Earth comes a new beginning

The street where starlets are made!

38608: Two detectives are tasked to investigate the murder of an old man, found bludgeoned to death in a Tokyo rail yard.
38864: Lillo (Christian De Sica) married Milena, one of the richest women in Europe. Filippo Vessato (Fabio De Luigi) is a young surgeon who, to make a career, is forced to suffer the harassment of his head, Professor Benci (Claudio Bisio). 39120: Two brave and smart young men: namely Police inspector Prabhat Singh (Sunny Deol) and a reformed criminal Akash Bhardwaj (Chunkey Pandey) is sent to the African country of Kenya in order to apprehend the underworld criminal Azghar Jhorat (Amrish Puri). While in Kenya they reaches up with a stern Kenyan police officer who is of Indian origin Surya Pratap Singh (Naseeruddin Shah), it is his duty to make Prabhat and Akash abide by the Kenyan laws but to capture Azghar both is forced to break the laws and gets into confrontation with Surya where a misunderstood is created. Will Akash and Prabhat be able to fulfilled there duties towards there country or will they leave there mission half way and run like cowards?
Tapasvi Gunjal (Ajghar's henchman and fiancee of Soniya)
39376: The story of an aspiring young filmmaker's encounter with a grumpy fount of movie lore.
39632: In Colombia, mining engineer Rian Mitchell discovers Carrero, the lost emerald mine of the Conquistadors, but has to contend with notorious local bandit El Moro's gang and with coffee planter Catherine Knowland's love.
Lovely GRACE KELLY in a new kind of man-danger!
39888: A successful lawyer struggles to deal with his wife's unfaithfulness and his own hidden past.
Great is the word for...COUNSELLOR AT LAW!
40144: A professor uses the three-card game to prove his probability thesis. He involves some of his students on his research and later realizes it was a big mistake
An Equation That Changed All Other Equations

Every man who sees her digs her... but she digs kicks of a very special kind!
40656: A marriage crisis between a writer and his wife leads her to flee to Germany and eventually return with another man, through whom the writer is going to overcome his writer's block.
The conflict of a love triangle
40912: At the airport, Slavi tells his life's story to a young customs officer. As children, Nelly promises Slavi to marry him. 41168: Slaughter, a former Green Beret, avenges the killing of loved ones by the Mob, and after being blackmailed by the feds, is forced to head to South America to finish the mobsters off.
It's not only his name, it's his business and sometimes--his pleasure!
41424: A modern retelling of Louisa May Alcott's classic novel, we follow the lives of four sisters - Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy March - detailing their passage from childhood to womanhood. 41680: A father and son who lived separate for some time meet one day to try to reconcile and understand their diametrical differences.
41936: A photographer’s road trip takes a dark turn when he befriends a reckless couple, plunging him into a nightmarish neo-noir spiral of unpredictable horror.
42448: Aymeric runs into Florence, a former coworker, one evening in Saint-Claude in the Haut-Jura. She is six months pregnant and single. When she gives birth to Jim, Aymeric is there. 42704: Eva, a young and promising Spanish lawyer based in Edinburgh, sees her wedding plans with the heir to an important and ultra-conservative Scottish family in jeopardy when she learns that her grandmother, Sofía, has decided to marry…
42960: Willie Dynamite is a pimp who operates in New York City. Willie was a big success as a pimp, but now, just as fast as he rose to the top, he has hit bottom. A former prostitute who has become a social worker tries to get Willie to clean up his life while it is still possible.
Ain't no one crosses WILLIE "D." He's tight, together, and mean. Chicks, Chumps, he uses 'em all. He's got to be Number-One.
43216: Jeanne, a shy young woman, works as a night guard at an amusement park and has a close relationship with her mother. While no man can compete with this opposed duo, Jeanne begins to develop strange romantic feelings for Jumbo, the latest attraction at the theme park...
43472: Paul lives with his mother in the private clinic of doctor Loisel, deeply hidden in the woods. Paul likes to roam the forest and observe nature. One day Gloria, a schizophrenic teenager of around fifteen years old, arrives, and Paul falls in love immediately.
43728: The fantastic story of how an ancient martial art, Chinese kung fu, conquered the world through the hundreds of films that were produced in Hong Kong over the decades, transformed Western action cinema and inspired the birth of cultural movements such as blaxploitation, hip hop music, parkour and Wakaliwood cinema.
How Hong Kong kicked off a cinematic revolution
43984: The tween, Mads, finds it hard to fit in. Having feelings for a girl in class and a clumsy farther who is a teacher at his school doesn't help. By an unforeseen chance of events, Mads becomes somewhat of a hero, but will he win the girl?
44496: A German Jewish industrialist is forced to hand over his business to the Nazis in order to ensure his family's safe passage out of Germany.
44752: A girl. A boy. A love story. But also about dreams, fears, life, true love, friendship and how we deal with it. And a secret between them...
45008: The journey of young, handsome New York City playboy Sam Wellman - man’s man and professional woman hater – and his relationship with Doc, his best (and only!) friend. Sam awakens the next morning to find himself transformed into a woman.
How do you get even with a womanizer? Make him a woman!
45520: A highly trained and exceptionally deadly swordsman looks for revenge after being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the assassination of an innocent woman's family.
45776: A NYPD officer imprisons and tortures an admitted cop-killer, but finds the tables turned when his victim refuses to break and in fact urges more punishment.
He is young, he is rich. He doesn't do it for money.
46032: Two childhood sweethearts love to hate each other due to their egos. What happens when they reconcile but their families begin warring each other instead?
46288: The story follows Akane, a girl with no self-confidence. Together, they set out from the basement for "Wonderland," and Akane finds herself labelled Wonderland's savior.
Today is your special day, but you are special every day.
46544: A seasoned FBI Agent's child-genius son assists him on catching a child-killer, a schizophrenic mohab nut who believes he's been chosen by god to be a new Noah.
A brutal slaying. An elusive killer. The chase is on.
46800: A university student's life transforms when he meets a unique, imaginative woman who challenges his rigid worldview and opens his heart to new possibilities.
47056: Catalonian Paco is a traveling rep for a shoe manufacturer. When he stops to pick up Russian emigree hitchhiker Nino, Paco soon finds himself on the side of the road with everything stolen out from under him. Local gift shop owner Marinette gives the Spaniard a lift. Their mutual attraction manifests itself quickly, and Paco, who was fired over the stolen-car episode, hangs around. When he happens to spot Nino in the same town, he beats up the scrawny Russian, who lands in the hospital. Oddly enough, this marks the beginning of a beautiful friendship. Paco and Nino soon take the trip down the road together
47312: A woman in love, a weak man, a father stumbling with his emotions, an uncle dependent on the past and a teenager meet at Zagor’s boarding house. Despite the serenity of the house, they all struggle to find the peace that they each need.

Klara and Lene also join the battle for the popular manufacturer, while waiter apprentice Mickey would rather just have a goat.
47824: In Istanbul, on the verge of a country-wide power surge, four characters come across in a neighborhood undergoing the process of gentrification for the “New Turkey”: a mother whose son is in prison, a young female dancer, a feminist artist, and a cunning middle man. 48592: The De La Mora siblings concoct a mischievous plan to break into their old family home to retrieve a hidden treasure of significant importance.
48848: A variety of aviation professionals such as pilots, flight attendants, the ground crew, mechanics, dispatchers, controllers, and the bird patrol crew all support a single flight. They have only one mission: to secure the safety of the passengers.
49104: Set in 1869, after the Civil War, Texas had not yet been readmitted to the Union and carpetbaggers, hiding behind the legal protection of the Union Army of occupation, had taken over the state. In trying to prove his innocence, Porter himself becomes a wanted man.
THUNDER IN HIS HEART...LIGHTNING IN HIS HOLSTERS...
49360: Strange events plague a recently widowed woman and her young daughter when they move to a small town.
49616: Young public prosecutor Keiichiro Okino is assigned to the department of the Tokyo Public Prosecutors Office that deals with violent cases, where he will work with Takeshi Mogami, whom he admires. 50128: The romantic story of Hungarian pianist Franz Liszt, whose scandalous love affair forced him to abandon his adoring audiences.
50384: An account of the life and work of Russian filmmaker Andrey Tarkovsky (1932-86) in his own words: his memories, his vision of art and his reflections on the fate of the artist and the meaning of human existence; through extremely rare audio recordings that allow a complete understanding of his inner life and the mysterious world existing behind his complex cinematic imagery.
50640: The wife of a wealthy industrialist finds herself caught-up in a web of intrigue & murder which was created by her own deceit. When she tries to escape the results of her actions, she too falls victim to deception.
Your throat dries, heart pounds, flesh crawls and you panic...that is the fear of...
50896: One of the greatest neuroscience breakthroughs is having discovered that babies are far more than a genetic load. The Beginning of Life invites everyone to reflect: are we taking good care of this unique moment, which defines both the present and future of humankind?
If we change the beginning of the story, we change the whole story.
51408: A Faustian tale about an old woman who makes a pact with Mephisto to regain her youth, but in return she must stay away from love. After making the deal, she meets two brothers who fall in love with her.
51664: The film tells an episode of the life of a kindly hearted bootblack who becomes accidentally the tutor of an orphan but nevertheless spends all his time and effort for the sake of the boy.
51920: A poor low-caste farmer wants to sacrifice his goat to deity Ondimuni for saving his son, but temple festivities are suspended due to upper-caste feuding. Can he fulfill his vow?
